title: TranscriptResult
description: The output of the transcript pipeline and the payload the node sends to the Worker.

lang.description: The language of the chosen track; null unless ok.

source.description: The kind of the chosen track; null unless ok.

word_count.description: Words of all pages together; 0 unless ok.

truncated.description: Whether the text was truncated; false unless ok.

sponsor_ratio.description: Share of the duration covered by sponsor segments; null when the status is not ok and when SponsorBlock failed.

pages.description: The transcript pages; empty unless ok.
